name: secret study
description: a small, windowless room hidden behind the bookcase. arcane symbols are carved into the stone walls, glowing with a faint, sickly green luminescence. in the centre, a stone pedestal holds a crystal skull that pulses with inner light. the air hums with an energy that makes your teeth ache. shadows seem to move independently of the light source.

items.name: crystal_skull
items.description: a perfectly carved skull made of clear crystal, slightly larger than a human skull. it pulses with an eerie inner light. touching it sends a chill through your entire body. tiny fractures spiderweb through its surface, as if it's been dropped. when you hold it, you hear a faint, distorted whisper.

items.name: pedestal
items.description: a stone pedestal covered in runes that glow with residual energy. in the center, a skull-shaped depression. the symbols are a warning: 'who bears the skull bears the burden. who returns it finds peace.'

items.name: journal
items.description: a leather-bound journal. the final entry, written in shaky handwriting: 'the skull is the key. take it to the altar in the crypt beneath the graveyard. but be warned — the doors will seal behind those who dare disturb the firstborn's rest. i have seen what happens to those who try to leave. god forgive me, i cannot stay. — augustus blackwood, october 30th, 1891'

items.name: candle
items.description: an unmarked black candle on a small table. it's unused but has been carved with tiny runes along its length.

items.name: dust_scattered
items.description: the floor of the secret study is covered in a fine layer of dust — except for a single set of footprints leading to the pedestal and back. small footprints, like a child's bare feet.
